style: Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, fine ink contours, flat pastel wildlife, ancient ivory/brass machinery, ink-black/violet spirits, warm ivory paper
scope: 25 playable story/exploration worlds; excludes four development/test levels. Home, Atelier and Overnight Train enemies are available in Arena practice; exploration stays peaceful.
status: Implemented as articulated procedural interpretations in src/enemies, with two attacks per species. Shared rigs and 15 attack patterns support the 100 roster entries.
